All unmeasured browser layout preflights pass and are bound before warmups/timed pairs. A failed preflight is a validation/source issue, never a timing result.

browserLayoutPreflight.appliesTo: VNDB, one A and one B full import per independent host before its ordinary warmups
browserLayoutPreflight.order: the host's assigned initial AB or BA order
browserLayoutPreflight.commandBoundary: Existing benchmark + all-media validation, with an identical source-bound test-only hook that runs after the existing timed interval and restart checks. Product package is untouched. All automatic timings in this phase are retained and excluded.
browserLayoutPreflight.hook: A unique checked source replacement invokes the external post-endpoint helper immediately after report.benchmark.validation is populated and before quick-mode return/context cleanup. Same hook bytes run in every A/B/C arm. Preflight mode exports bytes; ordinary mode hashes bounded ranges without retaining whole file copies. Original/overlay hashes and exact replacement are retained; all observations declare the explicit overlay source hash/dirty state.

export.io: Read-only OPFS File snapshots exported in fixed<=256KiB chunks via Playwright, incrementally written and SHA256-hashed by Node. Check exact offsets, lengths, per-chunk SHA256, base64 round trips and expected file sizes. Never materialize a complete large file in the browser or one CDP message.
proof: Run the unchanged production reader/decoder on the exported browser files and compare every logical row against the frozen natural-replay oracle.

Enumerate every new alias envelope/reference. Each must be in the prospectively recorded group and decode byte-for-byte to its original canonical raw-v6 definition; verify all175 affected row references.
Verify the entire original canonical content stream is preserved through the explicit relocation map, rather than broadly ignoring content bytes.

Verify all unaffected lookup payloads retain their expected native bytes; the eight promoted groups retain their complete original native prepared payloads. Decode all lookup/record rows, key/sequence postings, score/length values and ID ordering.

Canonical metadata must preserve IDs, hashes, logical lengths, dictionary families, dedup counts and original canonical targets after physical relocation; no canonical entry may be promoted to a new record-only alias.

Retain the raw pre/post-restart probe structures in this preflight and recompute the original physical probe digest plus a separate offset-independent semantic projection. Prove all intentional physical differences; do not replace the original digest silently.

Acquire and close exclusive sync-access handles for each term file after reads settle in a test-owned dedicated worker using the unchanged existing term-record-import-index-worker.js entry. No production worker protocol request is sent: in particular never send its destructive open action. The test evaluates only read-only handle acquisition/getSize/close in that worker and joins its termination. Existing SQLite runtime handles are outside this assertion.
Inventory before/after export and handle checks must be identical. Unexpected files, changed sizes during snapshotting, parser/import errors or cleanup warnings fail the preflight.
export.unrelatedStorage: Retain the complete normalized inventory and all available raw hashes. Media bytes and all-media digest remain exact. Stock SQLite SAH inventory/allocation checks remain exact (prospective current bound37 units), and unrelated semantic rows/metadata remain exact. Raw SQLite hashes contain permitted runtime metadata and are retained without claiming cross-run byte identity; no new normalization is allowed.

ordinaryAcquisition.hostBoundary: Six distinct fresh hosted job VMs; preserve host/browser/Node identities and never pool across hosts/orders. Exactly Node22.22.0, pinned Playwright Chromium binary, strict headless and no headed/storage fallback.
ordinaryAcquisition.perHostSchedule: Two excluded warmup pairs in initial then opposite order. Twelve measured A/B pairs alternate initial/opposite order. After pairs3,6,9,12 insert one unchanged A/C control pair, alternating AC/CA with the initial-order offset. Thus24 candidate observations +8 controls +4 excluded warmups per host.
ordinaryAcquisition.timing: Unchanged page file-input-change to post-UI import-complete monotonic endpoint. Fresh browser profile each observation, one complete pinned corpus, no phase tracing/screenshots/process sampling during ordinary import. Identical explicit bounded hash hook runs after existing restart/lookup/media validation; its work is excluded from the timing endpoint.
ordinaryAcquisition.media: Sampled media checks in every ordinary observation, followed by independent all-media A and B imports. No timing from exhaustive-media imports enters statistics.
ordinaryAcquisition.sourcePolicy: No retries, replacements, exclusions, extra blocks, trimmed tails or adapted flags. Stop on first failed required observation and preserve every attempted result.

statistics.resampling: 10000 complete-pair bootstrap draws with random.Random(897); resample paired indices jointly for millisecond differences and percent ratios, report sorted indices249 and9749 as descriptive95% bounds. Keep all raw pair vectors. No population-general confidence claim.

vndbAdvanceEachHost.controls: Both |median paired C/A percent| and |equal-work C/A percent| must be strictly less than half the smaller absolute candidate median-paired/equal-work percent saving.

nonTargetEachHost.controls: Both absolute median paired and equal-work C/A changes must be <=1%.

statistics.globalDecision: Both VNDB hosts and all four non-target cells must pass every semantic/source/memory gate. Any incomplete cohort, contrary equal-work result or failed control condition is inconclusive/hold regardless of a favorable statistic. A qualified timing pass may support a PR claim limited to these exact corpora/source/hosts; no pooling with d0 component results or PR977.

memory.sequence: After all ordinary and all-media observations, existing four-observation ABBA/BAAB instrumented memory schedule per host. Compose exact memory overlay with the same post-validation hash hook; import-window sampling gates remain unchanged and hash work is outside that interval.
memory.gates: Keep all existing process-tree PSS/private-byte coverage/scan-gap requirements, every observation qualified, median paired increase <=5%, maximum paired increase <=10% for both metrics. No observer-gap waiver.
memory.interpretation: Separate diagnostic memory screen, no timing contribution and no process-peak savings claim from operation counts.
